newsitem.title: UK: Provisional agenda for Bosnia peace conference.
newsitem.headline: Provisional agenda for Bosnia peace conference.

text.p: Here is the provisional agenda for the Peace Implementation Conference on Bosnia to be held in London this week. Please note details could still be changed:
1000 - Formal opening by British Prime Minister John Major

SESSION 1 - Review of what has been achieved since the signing of Dayton peace agreement last November. There will also be a military overview. International mediator Carl Bildt and representatives of the three Bosnian co-presidents, as well as officials from the major aid agencies and the United Nations, are also due to speak.

SESSION 2 - Implementation of Dayton's civilian aspects. Discussion of whether post of international mediator should continue to exist next year and if so, whether mediator's authority and coordinating powers could be strenghthened. Likely to include discussion on how to improve freedom of movement and identifying which targets to set for return of refugees, as well as talks on how to help new independent television network and restablishing national telephone system.
SESSION 4 - How to help create police forces in Bosnia which could command goodwill and trust of the population
SESSION 5 - What goals should be required from parties on Dayton's arms control commitments

SESSION 6 - Future economic development. Devising definitive programme for reform and restructuring of Bosnian economy, including establishment of a central bank and functioning ministries for economic management

SESSION 7 - Human rights. Likely to include discussion of how to persuade various Bosnian parties to live up to their commitments on cooperation with the international war crimes tribunal in the Hague.
